security_spec.violation_condition: In the Linux kernel, when a hart's LR reservation is not explicitly invalidated (via a dummy SC to a scratch word) before context-switching to a different thread, or before changing virtual-to-physical page mappings during migration, a subsequent SC in the newly-scheduled thread can spuriously succeed against the stale LR from the preempted thread, violating the SC-pairs-with-latest-LR-in-program-order rule across security boundaries.
security_spec.summary: LR reservation not invalidated on context switch or page migration: SC from new thread can pair with LR from old thread, breaking per-hart LR/SC atomicity across privilege domains
